Asphalt 3D.name: Asphalt 3D
Asphalt 3D.summary: Asphalt 3D brings all the excitement and speed of the Asphalt franchise to stereoscopic 3D, featuring more than 40 licensed vehicles, 17 exotic track locations and complete StreetPass functionality.

Classic Games Overload - Card & Puzzle E.name: Classic Games Overload: Card & Puzzle Edition
Classic Games Overload - Card & Puzzle E.summary: Classic Games Overload: Card & Puzzle Edition is a comprehensive card game collection; plus you get over 1,000 unique puzzle challenges! You get almost limitless gameplay.

Luxor.name: Luxor
Luxor.summary:
Embark on an expedition through ancient sands in this exciting action-puzzler.
A unique take on the match three puzzle, Luxor challenges you to think quickly and aim carefully as you explore the path of the Nile.

Tales of the World - Reve Unitia.name: Tales of the World: Reve Unitia
Tales of the World - Reve Unitia.summary: A tactics RPG for the Nintendo 3DS. Lloyd from Tales of Symphonia, Asbel from Tales of Graces f, Meredy from Tales of Eternia, Jade from Tales of the Abyss, Natalia also from Tales of the Abyss, and Yuri from Tales of Vesperia will make appearances in the game.
